keyFindings.description: The authSignIn case now refuses through s.deps.Approval.WriteRateLimited. cmd/broker-refgen resolves a class's refusals from authenticate's case (routes.go readAuthClasses) and does not follow the call into the approval package. So the generated reference at the head lists the 'Broker sign-in session' class's refusals as 'none' (it was 429 at 9558f6ed), and errors.md's RATE_LIMITED row drops 'every Broker sign-in session route'. That contradicts the class's own text ('Every route of the class spends its source address's bucket first'), and broker-refgen's tests still pass.
